name: Sticky Paws
counter: Serve their order or clear plated dishes before they pounce.
hint: Foxes steal plated dishes off the pass. When one starts eyeing it, serve them fast or carry the dish away.

name: Tantrum
counter: Raise their satisfaction before the tantrum lands.
hint: Monkeys throw food when unhappy. Feed a cranky monkey quickly to settle them down.

name: Restless
counter: Serve any course to settle them at their table.
hint: Restless guests change tables if ignored. A served course keeps them seated.

name: Wilting
counter: Serve them early - their mood decays twice as fast.
hint: Fish guests wilt fast: satisfaction drains quickly and patience runs short. Prioritize them.

name: Light Eater
counter: They fill up fast - small orders, quick turnarounds.
hint: Light eaters are satisfied with less. Quick, easy table turns.

name: Prime Cut
counter: Worth the patience: they fatten into a premium yield.
hint: Prime-cut guests hold more satisfaction and process into extra meat.

name: Bountiful
hint: Bountiful guests always leave a little extra behind in the Lounge.

name: Iron Stomach
counter: They happily eat anything - non-preferred dishes still land well.
hint: Iron-stomach guests accept any dish nearly as well as a favorite.
